title: NIFTY Auto P/E Ratio
description: The NIFTY Auto P/E ratio today is 30 as of 16 Oct, 2026, against a 10-year median of 31.4. Auto valuations turn on volume expectations rather than current earnings, so the multiple usually expands ahead of a demand recovery and compresses while sales are still growing.
